definitions.explanation: A disease that spreads from one person or animal to another through pathogens such as bacteria or viruses. Often used for illnesses that spread widely through a population.

examples.japanese: {伝染病|でんせんびょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
{伝染病|でんせんびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}する→予防する：17341_yobousuru⟧。
⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{伝染病|でんせんびょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とした→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
examples.english: In the past, many people lost their lives to infectious diseases.

notes:
A disease transmitted between hosts by pathogens. In everyday use it overlaps with ⟦{感染症|かんせんしょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧, though ⟦{感染症|かんせんしょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧ is the current preferred medical and legal term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝染病|でんせんびょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流行|りゅうこう}→流行：03678_ryuukou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: an infectious disease spreads / becomes prevalent
- {伝染病|でんせんびょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧: prevention of infectious disease
